Commentary.Commentary: Right. The chase is set to begin. West Indies players have walked out in the middle. Followed by Aaron Finch and Josh Philippe. Sheldon Cottrell to start with the ball.
Right then. The Aussies have to get a 200 run chase to get a second win of the series and make it 3-2. Or will the hosts create an upset? Join us for the chase in a while.

Well, haven't the Aussies come back stronger in the series. They have transcended their form from the last game. They had the momentum on their side and they rose up on the occasion. The pacey pair of Hazlewood and Behrendorf were the only bowlers who were not on the wickets column today. It was Zampa who struck early to knock Fletcher. out, he went onto pick up two wickets. Also, Marsh bagged two wickets in his spell but was a miser. Andrew Tye was the pick of the bowler as he bagged three wickets to put the hosts on the backfoot. Mitchell Swepson took a wicket as well of the big man Gayle. The Australian bowlers were in full control of the death overs.

Not upto the mark the West Indies side with their blade. They got off to a solid start but yet again Fletcher gets departed back on a low score. He has not been able to get runs on the board in this series. Lewis was the aggressor today, he played a good knock of 79 runs before making his way out. Also, Gayle was knocked out early after a blistering start of a 7-ball 21 runs. From the 14.4 over to 19.1 overs, West Indies only scored only 23 runs and lost five wickets in a short span. This put the hosts on the backfoot. In the end it was a cameo by Hayden Walsh which boosted the host to 199 runs at the end of 20 overs.
SIX! Cracking shot from Hayden Walsh! A full and wide outside off delivery, this time Walsh connects well enough for it to sail over long off for a biggie. WEST INDIES END AT 199 FOR 8.
On off, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Short ball, on middle, Hayden Walsh gets a top edge and it goes to the short third man fielder on one bounce.
Misses the slower wide delivery this time, tries to heave it over the on side, but misses.
Pitched up and wide outside off stump, Hayden Walsh swings and misses.
Sheldon Cottrell walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! Andrew Tye gets his second wicket! A slower length ball way outside off. Bravo throws the kitchen sink at it but ends up slicing it towards short third man where Aaron Finch takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Andrew Tye

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, outside off, left alone by Bravo. Wide called.
FOUR! Edged and Four! Full toss around off stump, Hayden Walsh goes hard at it, gets an outside edge which beats both the keeper and the diving third man fielder.
A back of a length ball on middle. Hayden Walsh tries to scoop it to fine leg, but misses it completely. The ball goes through to the keeper.
Good length ball on middle. Darren Bravo pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Hayden Walsh flicks the full ball on middle, towards on side for a run.
BEATEN! Good length ball around off stump, goes with the angle and Hayden Walsh misses it.
Good length ball on the stumps, Darren Bravo pulls it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Josh Hazlewood comes back into the attack for the penultimate over.
A length ball, on off, pushed to mid on for a single.
Outside off, left alone by Bravo.
Who will walk out next? It is Hayden Walsh.

OUT! CAUGHT! West Indies are falling apart like a pack of cards! Nicholas Pooran departs now and this is a good comeback from the Australian bowlers! A short ball on middle. Pooran gets on top of the bounce and goes for the pull but goes too hard on it. Hits it straight towards deep mid-wicket where Alex Carey charges forward and takes a superb catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Andrew Tye

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! A full ball way outside off. Left alone Wided.
A full otss on middle. Pooran looks to flick but gets a top edge, in the air and towards no-man land at mid on. Two taken.
Another full ball, just outside off. Pooran leaves it to the keeper.
WIDE! A full ball way outside off. Left alone. Wided.

DROPPED! Another catch dropped from an Australian fielder! A slower full ball on middle. Bravo looks to go big and lofts it towards long on. Josh Philippe in the deep runs across to his right and takes a low diving catch but pops it out in the end. Darren Bravo survives.
Darted on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a single. Bravo is off the mark.
Who will walk in at number 8? It is going to be Darren Bravo.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! This time Zampa carries it and Allen departs back cheaply. Another short ball on middle. Allen rocks back and smacks it straight towards the bowler. Adam Zampa gets his hand across in time and takes a brilliant catch. This is calling out trouble for the hosts.
A short ball on middle. Allen smacks it down the ground just short of Zampa.
Short ball on middle. Pooran pulls it to square leg for a single.
Darted on the pads, flicked away to mid-wicket for a single. Fabian Allen is off the mark.
Fuller ball outside off. Pooran works it to long off for one.
Adam Zampa comes back into the attack. His figures 3-0-26-1 so far.
A short of a length ball outside off. Allen dabs it to short third man.
Who will come out next? It is going to be Fabian Allen.

OUT! CAUGHT! No fireworks from Andre Russell this time! Huge wicket for Australia! A short of a length ball outside off. Rusell slashes at it, does not find the required distance, and hits it straight in the hands of Alex Carey at deep point who takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Andrew Tye

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! A short ball outside off. Left alone. Wided.
Another slower short ball outside off. Pooran pulls it through the hands of Tye towards long on for a single.
A slower length ball, outside off. Pooran cuts it but finds the backward point fielder.
A length ball outside off. Pushed to covers for a single.

DROPPED! This could prove very costly! A pacy short ball on middle. Pooran goes for the pull but mistimes it completely, gets a top edge towards mid-wicket. Tye runs across and settles under it but spills it out in the end. Single taken and Pooran survives.
Andrew Tye comes back into the attack.
A length ball, on off. Russell defends it back to the bowler with a straight bat. Just 7 runs and a wicket off the over.
A full length ball, on off. Pooran nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Andre Russell is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Change of angle does the trick for Mitchell Marsh. He picks up his second wicket in his second over. He has reignited his form in this tour. Serves a length ball, on off. Simmons looks to heave it away on the leg side but mistimes it completely. The ball takes the leading edge and goes towards backward point. Andrew Tye gets under it and take a sharp catch. West Indies are four wickets down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Andrew Tye b Mitchell Marsh

Commentary.Commentary: Play and a miss! A touch short, outside off. Simmons moves across and looks to heave it away but misses. The ball goes through to the keeper.
Keeps it full and outside off. Simmons looks to push it out but misses.
SIX! Freebies. Simmons won't let it go to waste. A full toss on off. Simmons stays and smokes it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Mitchell Marsh comes back into the attack.
Just missed! A touch fuller ball, just around leg stump. Pooran swivels across and looks to flick it but misses. The ball zips past the leg stump to the keeper.
A slower short ball on middle. Simmons pulls it with eases to square lg for one.
On middle. Simmons flicks it in front of square leg for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Well played! A length ball outside off. Simmons shimmies down the track and slashes it to deep point for a boundary.
Full ball on middle. Pooran flicks it to square leg for a single.
Good length ball on middle. Simmons tucks it on the leg side for a single. Ohh wait, No ball has been called for overstepping. Free-Hit coming up.
Length ball on middle. Blocked back to the bowler.
Josh Hazlewood comes back into the attack now. His figure's so far 2-0-15-0.
On middle, tucked on the leg side. So, 25 runs coming of this over. An expansive one for Australia.
Flatter and quicker outside off. Pooran swings and misses.
FOUR! Nicholas Pooran is enjoying himself out there in the middle! Another short ball on middle. Pooran clears his front foot and pulls it towards square leg for a boundary.
SIX! Mitchell Swepson is under tremendous pressure! A short ball on middle. Pooran rocks back and heaves it over mid-wicket for a six.
WIDE! Tossed up, down the leg side. Pooran misses his flick. Wided.
SIX! Another one! Nicholas Pooran is already on the upper gear! Another fuller ball outside off. Pooran slashes it over covers for a biggie.
SIX! This will release some pressure. A full ball on middle. Pooran lofts it over long on for a biggie.
TWO WIDES! Sees Simmons coming down the track, Swepson goes fuller and way down the leg side. Simmons gets his left foot out and ricochets it towards short fine leg and takes a single.
A single to end the over. Flatter and on off, Simmons cuts it through point for another single.
Mitchell Swepson is back into the attack.
Tossed up, on off. Simmons goes back and flicks it to square leg.
Flatter and outside off. Pooran cuts it through point for a single.
LEG BYE! Looped up, on off. Simmons looks to push it away but misses. The ball rolls out of the pads. The batters sneak a leg bye.
On off, kept out.
A loud appeal for LBW turned down. Loopy ball, on off. Simmons looks to flick it away but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Zampa appeals but the umpire is unmoved.

OUT! CAUGHT! The extra ball proves to be very costly for West Indies, as the set batsman Lewis has to depart. Mitchell Marsh is delivering everytime when his side needs him. What a tour he is having. Just amazing. Serves a length ball, on off. Lewis stays back and looks to go big. He does not middle it though. The ball goes off the top edge. It flies towards mid-off. The substitute fielder Nathan Ellis gets under it and takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Nathan Ellis b Mitchell Marsh

Commentary.Commentary: Nicholas Pooran walks out to bat now.
WIDE! A short ball, on off. Lewis ducks under a bit. The ball goes over the batter's head. Wide called. Marsh has to reload the last delivery.
Full and outside off, Simmons moves across and pushes it to covers for a single.
Full and outside off. Simmons looks to chase it but misses. The ball ends up with the keeper.
Full and outside off, Lewis drives it to sweeper cover for a run.
On a length, outside off. Simmons stays back and punches it to cover for another single.
Serves a full length ball, on off. Lewis clips it to mid on for a single.
Mitchell Marsh is into the attack for the first time.
Tossed up, on middle and off, Lewis stays back and nudges it to mid-wicket for another single.
Floated on off, Simmons flicks it to square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Simmons goes back and looks to flick it but misses. The ball rolls to the off side off the pads.
Looped up, full and on off. Simmons pushes it to point.
On off, pushed to the off side for a single.
On leg Simmons tucks it to square leg and scamper through.
Adam Zampa is back into the attack. His figures till now read 1-0-20-1.
Tossed up, on off. Lewis defends it out solidly.

SIX! IN THE GAP! BANG! Make it four in a row. Looped up, on off. Lewis pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. The fielders there chases it but the ball sails by comfortably. Lewis is racing away towards the century.

SIX! DISPATCHED! Overpitched on off, Lewis stays back and goes with it. He powers it it over the long on fence for a maximum. This makes his third consecutive six. He got two in his last two deliveries.
Full and on off. Simmons drills it to long on for a single.
Tossed up and outside off, Simmons waits and guides it to short third man.
Loopy ball, on off. Simmons stays back and pushes it to cover.
SIX! Back to back sixes and 100 up for the West Indies! A good length ball, outside off. Lewis stands tall and lofts it over long on for a six.
SIX! Beautiful shot! A length ball outside off. Evin Lewis flat bats it over long off where the fielder leaps near the ropes but sees the ball sail over him for a six.
On a length, on middle. Lewis nudges it on the leg side.
FOUR! Placement! 50 up for Evin Lewis! First of this series! A length ball, outside off. Lewis cuts it past point for a boundary.
Another fuller ball, just outside off. Lewis looks to squeeze it out but misses.
WIDE! A full ball, way outside off. Left alone. Wided.
Tye starts with a knuckle ball on a fuller length, on middle. Simmons checks his shot and chips it uppishly over mid-wicket. Single taken.
Andrew Tye comes into the attack now.
A tossed up ball, spinning away on middle and leg. Lewis looks to heave it but mistime it. Gets hit on the pads. Australia optimistically appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved.
A short ball outside off. Lewis looks to cut but fails to connect any bat on it.
Tossed up, outside off. Lewis prods forward to defend it on the off side.
WIDE! A full ball, spilling down the leg side. Lewis misses his sweep. Wided.
Who will come out next? It is going to be Lendl Simmons.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mitchell Swepson sends the big man, Chris Gayle packing in his first over. It was a googly which was pitched full and wide outside off stump, Chris Gayle looks to go big over long off, but gets only a top edge which goes high in the night sky and it is Jason Behrendorff who gets under it and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Behrendorff b Mitchell Swepson

Commentary.Commentary: Flaoted on off, Lewis flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Loopy ball, on off. Gayle pushes it to mid off for a single.
Mitchell Swepson comes into the attack now. He replaces Adam Zampa.
FOUR! Full toss outside off stump and this time he thrashes it straight, which beats mid off for a boundary. This also marks the end of Powerplay. West Indies are on 84/2.
Full ball outside off, Evin Lewis shoulders arms.
Good length ball, outside off, left alone by Lewis. Lewis was put off by the towel which fell when Behrendorff was striding his delivery.
WIDE! A full length ball, wide outside off. Lewis leaves it alone. Wide called.
SIX! And again! This time he goes downtown! Full ball and just outside off stump, Evin Lewis hits it over long off for a maximum.
SIX! HUGE! Slower ball from Jason Behrendorff on a length and on off. Evin Lewis waits and smacks this over deep mid-wicket region for a maximum.
FOUR! Lovely timed shot! Full and wide ball, Evin Lewis drives it crisply through extra cover for a boundary.
Change of ends for Jason Behrendorff. He comes in form the pavilion end this time. He replaces Josh Hazlewood. His figures are 2-0-25-0 so far.
SIX! Chris Gayle making his present fell early on! Goes full and on middle. Gayle gets low and heaves it over long on for another biggie. So, despite the wicket, 20 runs coming off this over.
FOUR! Gayle storm has arrived! A short ball, around off. Gayle rocks back and cuts it past point for a boundary.
SIX! BANGED! Pitches it up, in the arc, around middle. Gayle gets on the knee and slogs it over mid-wicket for a biggie. 50 up for West Indies.
Around off, flatter ball. Gayle blocks it out.
FOUR! Chris Gayle is off the mark in style! Pitches it up, outside off. Gayle leans forward and drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
Who will walk out next? It is the Universe Boss, Chris Gayle who walks out at number three with his sword.

OUT! TIMBER! Fletcher didn't see that coming! Australia gets the crucial breakthrough and Andre Fletcher continues to struggle to get runs in this series! Adam Zampa starts with a fuller ball almost a yorker length around middle and leg. Fletcher doesn't read it and fails to dig it out. The ball sneaks through and hits the stumps
Adam Zampa comes into the attack now. He replaces Jason Behrendorff.
Fuller delivery on middle. Fletcher flicks it in front of square leg for a single.
SWING AND A MISS! A pacy short ball, on middle. Andre Fletcher dances down the track and looks to pull it but fails to get any bat on it.
Good delivery! Yorker length on middle. Lewis digs it out in time towards mid-wicket for a single.
A short of a length ball, on middle. Fletcher pulls it to square leg for one run.
SIX! BANG! Magnificent strike. A length delivery, on off. Fletcher moves across and makes room for himself. He then powers it over the long on fence for a biggie.
A length ball, on off. Fletcher plays it back to the bowler.
SIX! Flat six! A full ball, angling down the leg side. Lewis gets low and slog sweeps it over square leg boundary for a biggie. 16 coming off this over.

In the air..Safe! A short of a length ball, on middle. Lewis waits for the ball and goes for the pull but miscues it. Hits it straight in the air and over the bowler's head, where the ball lands in no-mans land.
A back of a length ball, around off. Lewis pushes it to covers.
SIX! Takes full toll of the Free-Hit! A lof full toss on middle. Lewis smokes it over long on for a biggie.
NO BALL! Another free hit to follow as Jason Behrendorff overstepped again. A length ball outside off. Lewis swings and misses. Free-Hit coming up.
NO BALL! A length ball, on middle. Fletcher tucks it on the leg side for a single. No ball given for overstepping. Free-Hit coming up.
A back of a length ball on middle. Fletcher looks to heave it without any feet movement but fails to connect any bat on it.
A good length ball, on middle. Lewis tucks it on the leg side and takes a quick single.
A length ball, on middle. Evin Lewis stays back and clips it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Lewis gets the first boundary of the day. A good length ball, on off. Evin Lewis stays back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
A length ball, on off. Fletcher works it towards third man for a single.
A length ball, on middle. Fletcher stays back and nudges it to the leg side.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.
A length ball, on off. Fletcher pushes it to cover.
A length ball, on off. Fletcher defends  it out solidly.
SIX! First maximum of the innings! A full ball, on off. Evin Lewis stands tall and heaves it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Touch fuller around off. Fletcher swivels across and looks to defend but gets outer half of his blade to third man. Single taken.
Another good length ball, on middle. Fletcher gets behind the line of the ball and blocks it out.
A good length ball, slanting across, outside off. Fletcher lets it through to the keeper.
A length ball, outside off. Lewis pushes it to through point for a single. He is off the mark as well.
TAP AND RUN! Starts with a back of a length ball, on off. Andre Fletcher hops and defends it to the off side for a quick single. Fletcher and West Indies are underway.
The Australia players make their way out in the middle. Followed by Andre Fletcher and Evin Lewis.  Jason Behrendorff to start with the ball.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Andre Fletcher, Evin Lewis, Chris Gayle, Lendl Simmons, Darren Bravo (IN PLACE OF AKEAL HOSEIN), Nicholas Pooran (C/WK), Andre Russell, Fabian Allen, Hayden Walsh, Sheldon Cottrell, Oshane Thomas.

Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), Josh Philippe (IN PLACE OF ASTON TURNER), Mitchell Marsh, Moises Henriques, Alex Carey, Matthew Wade (WK), Andrew Tye (IN PLACE OF RILEY MEREDITH), Jason Behrendorff, Adam Zampa, Mitchell Swepson (IN PLACE OF DAN CHRISTIAN, Josh Hazlewood (IN PLACE OF MITCHELL STARC).
TOSS - Up goes the coin and lands in the favor of West Indies. They have elected to BAT first.

Hello and welcome to the 5th and the final T20I between West Indies and Australia. With the series at 1-3 already in the favour of the hosts, all Australia would target is to get back-to-back wins. On the other hand, West Indies will look to shed the disappointment of the previous defeat and will aim to come back strongly. Will Australia manage to finish on a high? Or will West Indies finish the series with yet another win? Let's find out. Stay tuned for toss and lineups.
